about: NEXUS built-in artwork database. Each entry is applied only when the game is identified with certainty (see README, 'Game artwork').

entries.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Nintendo Switch 2 remake, 2026)
names: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake
entries.note: Artwork supplied by the owner of this NEXUS build. The 2026 remake is a Nintendo Switch 2 game; the original Nintendo 64 game and Ocarina of Time 3D (Nintendo 3DS) were never released as standalone Switch titles, and fan ports are homebrew or carry other publishers, so they are not matched. No Title ID is listed because none has been officially published; add one here once confirmed from your own copy.
